subject: Request: Trial runway extension + promo credit for SAP connector stall
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@ledgerworks.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procure@ledgerworks.io
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: SAP connector blocking POC - can you help with credits/extension?

Hi Marcus,

Quick note — our engineering team hit a blocker with the SAP ECC connector while trying to validate the data sync for the POC. The SAP team requires an extra round of certs and we've been told the change will take ~3 weeks (they found an auth token mismatch that needs a patch). That pushes our demo window past the trial expiry.

We're still committed and want to push the pilot forward, but we don't have enough sandbox credits to continue testing while this is being fixed. Can Redwood extend our trial window by 30 days and provide some promo credits to cover the additional tokenized inference and embedding runs? If you can approve that it would keep momentum with our Execs.

Attaching a short log snippet (sap_error_log.txt) that our infra lead pulled. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, LedgerWorks
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@ledgerworks.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SAP connector blocking POC - can you help with credits/extension?

Hi Samir — thanks for the context and the log. Sorry to hear about the auth mismatch — I know those can be painful with on-prem SAP stacks.

A couple quick things from our side so we can move this through:
- Can you confirm the expected timeline from your SAP team (start date for the patch + estimated testing window)?
- Rough estimate of sandbox usage over those 30 days (tokens/embedding units) so we can size the promo credit.
- Any compliance or network restrictions (e.g., dedicated VPC, IP ranges) that would affect our temporary test infra?

Evelyn and Jordan — looping you in to get an opinion on a short runway extension and promotional top-up. My initial thought: 30-day extension + a promo credit bucket to cover the incremental usage. If CS signs off we can issue the extension and apply a one-off credit.

Samir — happy to set up a 20-min alignment if that helps accelerate this.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Exec — East
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SAP connector blocking POC - can you help with credits/extension?

Thanks for the ping. Reviewed the log — looks like a token negotiation failure on the SAP side; LedgerWorks will need the patch + one regression run to validate. They mentioned three weeks but based on similar cases I think 2–4 weeks is realistic.

Recommendation (CS):
- Approve a 30-day trial extension immediately to prevent churn.
- Apply a promotional credit worth $5,000 (covers test traffic and a couple of heavy embedding runs).
- Offer an optional 1-hour engineering office hours session with Jordan (solutions) to review integration best practices after the patch.

Constraints: any credit >$5k will need pre-approval from RevOps; anything that changes their contract length needs Legal review.

If you approve, I can draft the amendment and trigger the credit.

Evelyn
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@ledgerworks.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procure@ledgerworks.io
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SAP connector blocking POC - can you help with credits/extension?

Marcus / Evelyn — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear recommendation. 30 days + $5k should cover us while SAP pushes the patch. We would also welcome Jordan's office hours.

Next steps on our side: procurement will need an updated trial amendment or a PO line that notes the extension and promo credit for accounting. Can you send something we can route to our finance team?

Appreciate the help — Samir
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@ledgerworks.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SAP connector blocking POC - can you help with credits/extension?

Samir — all set. We approved a 30-day trial extension (new expiry: 2027-07-28) and applied a $5,000 promotional credit to LedgerWorks' sandbox account. Jordan will reach out to schedule the 1-hour office hours next week.

Attached: extension_amendment.pdf (amendment summary + signatures block). For procurement: DocuSign link to the amendment and a HubSpot record for the amendment are below. If procurement needs an invoice/PO line, reply and I will loop in RevOps and Legal for the formal paperwork.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/LDG-4821-amendment
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ledgerworks

Thanks — glad we could keep the POC on track.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Exec — East
Redwood Inference
Attachments: extension_amendment.pdf (PDF, 40KB)
